data.one_liner: Render sparkline charts for fast data visualization on Flutter apps
data.what_it_does: Provides simple widgets for rendering sparkline charts like lines, bars, and columns in Flutter. Allows configuring dimensions, custom colors, axis rendering, and min/max limits.
use_when: You need lightweight sparkline charts embedded inside lists, tables, or dense dashboards
You want to display line, bar, or column charts quickly with minimal setup
avoid_when: You need complex interactive charts with tooltips, zooming, and pan gestures
You require advanced legends, tooltips, or grid lines beyond basic sparkline needs
strengths: Easy to use with straightforward widgets like TinyLineChart, TinyBarChart, and TinyColumnChart
Supports multiple data formats including Offsets, raw lists, and vector_math Vector2
Provides helpful customization options such as custom colors for positive/negative values, highest/lowest points, and axes
weaknesses: Limited documentation on advanced features or complete API coverage
Designed primarily for minimalist sparklines rather than fully-featured analytics charts

alternatives.name: fl_chart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick fl_chart if you need fully interactive, highly customizable charts with animations and touch gestures.

alternatives.name: syncfusion_flutter_charts
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick syncfusion_flutter_charts for enterprise-grade, feature-rich charts with extensive types and performance optimizations.
